def bbolt.spExact (pg kb : List w8) (L : List Int) : Bool :=
  decide (∃ j, j ∈ L ∧ bbolt.branchKey pg j.toNat = kb)

def bbolt.spPred (pg kb : List w8) (i : Int) : Bool :=
  decide ¬go.GoStringLt (bbolt.branchKey pg i.toNat) kb

theorem bbolt.rdTxK.congr_simp [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (K K✝ : bbolt.BC) (e_K : K = K✝) (tx tx✝ :
    Loc) (e_tx : tx = tx✝) (src src✝ : bbolt.PairSrc) (e_src : src = src✝) (q q✝ : Qp) (e_q : q =
    q✝) (T T✝ : bbolt.TxView) (e_T : T = T✝) (v v✝ : bbolt.View) (e_v : v = v✝) : bbolt.rdTxK K tx
    src q T v = bbolt.rdTxK K✝ tx✝ src✝ q✝ T✝ v✝

theorem bbolt.Bucket.pageNode_r.spec.congr_simp [hos : HasExt osFsExt] :
    bbolt.Bucket.pageNode_r.spec = bbolt.Bucket.pageNode_r.spec

theorem bbolt.sp_route (pg kb : List w8) (L : List Int) (idx : Int) (hc0 : 0 < bbolt.pageCount pg)
    (hsorted : ∀ (i j : Nat), i < j → j < bbolt.pageCount pg → go.GoStringLt (bbolt.branchKey pg i)
    (bbolt.branchKey pg j)) (H0 : 0 ≤ idx) (Hfound : idx < ↑(bbolt.pageCount pg) → bbolt.spPred pg
    kb idx = true) (Hoob : (∀ (i : Int), 0 ≤ i ∧ i < ↑(bbolt.pageCount pg) → bbolt.spPred pg kb i =
    false) → idx = ↑(bbolt.pageCount pg)) (Hgt : ∀ (k : Int), 0 ≤ k ∧ k < idx → bbolt.spPred pg kb k
    = false) (Hev : idx < ↑(bbolt.pageCount pg) → idx ∈ L) (hL : ∀ (j : Int), j ∈ L → 0 ≤ j ∧ j <
    ↑(bbolt.pageCount pg)) : have ri := if bbolt.spExact pg kb L = true then idx else if 0 < idx
    then idx - 1 else idx; bbolt.branchRoute pg kb ri.toNat ∧ 0 ≤ ri ∧ ri < ↑(bbolt.pageCount pg)
